summary: This paper compares three freestanding few-layer Ti3C2Tx films produced from LiF/HCl-etched MXene: unmodified Ti3C2Tx, annealed thiourea-treated NS-Ti3C2Tx-A, and mercury-lamp photothermal thiourea-treated NS-Ti3C2Tx-P. The photothermal N/S co-doped NS-Ti3C2Tx-P is the primary and best-performing electrode, reaching 424 F g−1 and 1023 F cm−3 at 2 mV s−1 in 2 M H2SO4. NS-Ti3C2Tx-A and Ti3C2Tx reach 358 and 330 F g−1, respectively, at the same scan rate. Film thickness, lateral flake size, pore diameter, porosity, BET surface area, tortuosity, and areal capacitance were not reported.
